svg.text: 60 W x 58 D x 110 H mm (lid included); flat foot 43 x 42; shell ~45 cm3, ~153 g with board 30 g + battery 55 g (assumed)
centre of mass 23 behind the foot's front edge, 48 up; tips at ~21° back / 25° forward (worst direction 21°); tilt15: 22 / 29, oval: 18 / 17
One soft stone: egg outline in front, long convex back, the underside rounds in to a small flat foot.
Front: straight along the 15° lean over the slots, bowed across the width like the oval's (4.55 on the centre line, 3.0 at the glass edge); inner face flat.
Underside R7.5: its first 45° are the lid's edge (the lid prints flat), the shell starts at the rim at 45°, so it prints standing on the rim without supports.
Dome: outside free; inside a 45° tent and a small flat bridge, so the top wall grows from 3 to about 7 without a step.
1 mm = 4 px, grid 10 mm. Blue-grey: stack box s 12..95 (along the face from the rim), t 3..26; dashed in it: real board+glass and battery. Blue: rods 8 x 66.65 at x ±10.23. Red: CoM, flat foot.
front edges of the contours show the bow (1.55 at x 15.9)
SECTION A–A horizontal cut at z 57
1 mm = 4 px, front at the bottom
DETAIL 3x (1 mm = 12 px): the front wall in the same cut
outer face bowed across the width like the oval's, inner face flat;
slots: 8.1 x 0.6 land at the inner face, then 45° out to the bowed face, straight ends
rod 8 x 4, crown 0.54 under the face
Wall, perpendicular to the face (this cut shows it x1.035): 4.55 on the centre line, 4.09 at the slot centre,
3.09 at x 15.6, 3.00 at x 15.9 (oval: 4.55 / 4.16 / 3.21 / 3.00). The bow is the same at every height of the face;
along the lean the face is straight over the slots (a crown of up to 0.5 over their 67 mm is possible, see the text).
